For a while we watched the
City of the Rats burn.
1:
The rising smoke blotted out the sun.
Then a terrible thought came to me.

This smoke is like a signal fire.
A signal telling the Shadow Lord about us.
2: We hurried away from the city.

10: That Lief has recovered three of the gems.
11: I wonder… But we'd better assume it does.
12: Hmm. It never hurts to be careful.

81: (I have a good idea. Leave it to me.)

99: I don't like how you put that.
102:
We entered the Games, and before
we knew it, we were in the finals…

The last ones left were the
three of us and one stranger…
106: (If any of us three wins, we get the gold, right?)
107: (We've come this far, let's fight fair.) (Isn't that only right, for those we beat?)
114:
Jasmine is strong when she's angry…
Really strong.
115:
Barda and I weren't on our guard,
and Jasmine beat us easily…
116: Jasmine, take care not to get hurt!
118: What's the matter… I'm still standing.

121: Mother, you say!? Home, you say!?
124: You did it! You're the Champion!
126: I… When he mentioned my mother, I lost my temper… Rage took over my heart. The match was over, and I kept on attacking… And I enjoyed it. If Lief hadn't stopped me…
127: Forget it. You fought for your life and won. That's all.
128: That's right! And look at all this gold!
129: I wonder if I should take it…
130: It's up to you, Jasmine. Right, Lief?
132: Then I'll take it. Each time I spend it, I'll remember how frightening it is to lose myself.
134: Remember not to make Jasmine angry.
136:
We left town by a back way that
Mother Brightly, who runs the inn,
told us about.
137:
She said robbers after the prize
made the front way dangerous.
138:
But Father, just outside town we
were attacked and knocked out.

If that man hadn't saved us, who
knows what would have happened…
140: You're… the man from the final!?
141: Hmph… You certainly did as you pleased.
142: You're the one who attacked us!
143: I saved you from your attackers. A little thanks would be nice.
145: I am Doom. Leader of the Resistance.
146: What! The Resistance, who fight the Shadow Lord!?
148: Why would their leader enter those Games?

156: It's dangerous out there. The Grey Guards are looking for you.

161: …I don't know who to trust any more.

166: You said it. We can't trust anyone. That goes for him too. He may lure us to his hideout to get our secret out of us.
167: Right. Better to fight Grey Guards than be fooled by a stranger.
168:
Father… To trust no one…
It's frightening, and lonely.
170: The Shifting Sands shouldn't be far.
172: Look, it's that way! Trust Kree!
175: I'm glad I have friends I can trust.
176: …Yes. But even I make mistakes sometimes.
177: Yes, I know that very well.
179: Jarred… You have a fine son.

182: We have to find a gem in this!?

184: Right, let it give us a welcome!
188: There's something out there, that's for sure.

204:
To live on alone and continue
the quest… No, I must go on…
I must recover the gems…

But… oh, Barda, Jasmine…
207: I see. Things lost by travellers swallowed by the sand end up here…
210: Oh, really. Was that pathetic voice truly Lief's?

223:
The opal is a stone of holy power,
strongly linked to the lapis lazuli,
which also wards off evil.
224: The lapis lazuli must be here! That's why the opal it's linked to is shining!
229:
Father,
that's how we found the lapis lazuli.

Our journey is full of hardship,
but we're alive. One thing worries me.
230:
Rumours about us seem to be spreading.
Has the Shadow Lord heard them?
